entry.name: Tram Kim Lam
entry.department: Environmental Epidemiology Branch, Epidemiology and Genomics Research Program, Division of Cancer Control and Population Sciences

evidence.currentRole: [Individual NCI profile](https://epi.grants.cancer.gov/staff/lam.html), opened this run — "Branch Chief"; Environmental Epidemiology Branch. The biography describes leadership of program directors and oversight of an extramural research-grant portfolio.
evidence.doctorateOrPapers: [NCI profile](https://epi.grants.cancer.gov/staff/lam.html) — Ph.D. in Epidemiology, Johns Hopkins University, Bloomberg School of Public Health.
evidence.vietnameseSignal: Vietnamese given-name token Tram appears explicitly in the full name Tram Kim Lam on the [employer profile](https://epi.grants.cancer.gov/staff/lam.html); this signal is additional to the ambiguous surname Lam.
evidence.location: [EGRP visitor information](https://epi.grants.cancer.gov/about/) — "Location", "4th Floor, East Tower", "9609 Medical Center Drive", "Rockville, MD 20850". This is her program's physical worksite, distinguished on the page from its Bethesda postal address.
evidence.dedup: Checked public/data.json for Tram Kim Lam, Kim Tram Lam, Lam Kim Tram, and the profile URL; no matches. Ran npm run find-roster-matches for Tram Kim Lam and Lam Kim Tram with the profile URL; both returned "no roster or retired-id matches". No exact name-order matches in maintenance/sector-expansion/already-proposed.txt. Confirmed existing employer spelling National Cancer Institute.
